title: Past Perfect Continuous и обзор всех прошедших времён

why: Past Perfect Continuous показывает процесс, который длился до другого момента в прошлом и часто объясняет его результат: «Он устал, потому что работал всю ночь». В русском здесь хватает одного прошедшего времени, а в английском нужно показать, что процесс был раньше и длился какое-то время.
formation: • Утверждение: She had been waiting for an hour.
• Отрицание: She hadn't been waiting long.
• Вопрос: Had she been waiting long? How long had she been waiting?
usage: 1. Процесс длился до момента в прошлом: She had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally came. (Она ждала уже час, когда наконец пришёл автобус.)
2. Причина состояния в прошлом, результат виден: The ground was wet. It had been raining. (Земля была мокрая. Шёл дождь.)
3. Глаголы состояния (know, be, want, like) в Continuous не ставим: I had known him for years. (Я знал его много лет.)
• Past Simple — факт или цепочка событий: I opened the door and saw a cat.
• Past Continuous — процесс в момент в прошлом: At 7 I was cooking.
• Past Perfect — действие закончилось ДО другого момента в прошлом: When I arrived, they had left.
• Past Perfect Continuous — процесс шёл ДО другого момента в прошлом: I had been waiting for an hour when they called.

Как выбрать: сначала спросите себя, что случилось раньше. Если раньше и это результат или факт, нужен Past Perfect. Если раньше и это длительный процесс, нужен Past Perfect Continuous. Если события идут по порядку, достаточно Past Simple.
signalWords: for, since, all day, all morning, how long, before, by the time, when, because, already.
mistakes: ✗ I was tired because I was working all day. → ✓ I was tired because I had been working all day. (причина была раньше состояния)
✗ She had been wait for an hour. → ✓ She had been waiting for an hour. (после been нужна форма -ing)
✗ He had been knowing her for years. → ✓ He had known her for years. (know не ставим в Continuous)
✗ When I came, they were already left. → ✓ When I came, they had already left. (завершённое действие до другого момента — Past Perfect)
✗ How long did you learn English before you moved? → ✓ How long had you been learning English before you moved? (процесс до момента в прошлом)
remember: had been + V-ing — процесс, который шёл ещё до нужного момента в прошлом.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в Past Perfect Continuous

items.prompt: He was tired because he ___ (work) all night.
She ___ (wait) for an hour when the bus finally came.
The ground was wet. It ___ (rain).
We ___ (look) for the file for two hours before we found it.
My eyes hurt because I ___ (stare) at the screen all day.
They ___ (not / sleep) well, so they looked exhausted.
items.answer: hadn't been sleeping / had not been sleeping

items.prompt: How long ___ you ___ (learn) English before you moved? (два пропуска)
He ___ (drive) for six hours when the car broke down.
I was exhausted because I (a) worked (b) had been working (c) was worked for ten hours.
When the phone rang, I (a) was taking (b) had taken (c) had been taken a shower.
She (a) had left (b) was leaving (c) leaves before I arrived, so I didn't see her.
I couldn't get in because I (a) lost (b) had lost (c) was losing my keys.
While we (a) were walking (b) had walked (c) had been walking in the park, it started to rain.
He (a) had been living (b) lived (c) was living in Kyiv for five years before he moved to Warsaw.
After she (a) had finished (b) was finishing (c) finish the report, she went home.
The streets were wet. It (a) rained (b) had been raining (c) was rained.

exercises.instruction: Соедините предложения, используя слово в скобках

items.prompt: Tom was tired. He ran for two hours. (because)
items.answer: Tom was tired because he had been running for two hours.

items.prompt: First I finished the task. Then I went home. (After)
items.answer: After I had finished the task, I went home.

items.prompt: She was covered in paint. She painted the wall all morning. (because)
items.answer: She was covered in paint because she had been painting the wall all morning.

items.prompt: The train left at 5:00. I arrived at 5:10. (When I arrived, ...)
items.answer: When I arrived, the train had left. / When I arrived, the train had already left.

items.prompt: We started waiting at 2 p.m. At 4 p.m. the guest still wasn't there. (By 4 p.m. ... for two hours)
items.answer: By 4 p.m. we had been waiting for two hours.

items.prompt: He studied German for years. Then he moved to Berlin. (Before)
items.answer: Before he moved to Berlin, he had studied German for years. / Before he moved to Berlin, he had been studying German for years.

items.prompt: My hands were dirty. I was fixing the car. (because)
items.answer: My hands were dirty because I had been fixing the car.

items.prompt: She felt nervous. She had never given a presentation before. (because)
items.answer: She felt nervous because she had never given a presentation before.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глаголы в нужное прошедшее время (два пропуска, ответы по порядку через /)

items.prompt: When I ___ (get) home, my wife ___ (cook) dinner.
By the time he ___ (arrive), the meeting ___ (already / start).
It ___ (snow) for hours, so the roads ___ (be) closed.
While I ___ (wait) for the bus, I ___ (see) an old friend.
He ___ (not / answer) because he ___ (sleep).
After they ___ (finish) the project, they ___ (celebrate).
I ___ (try) to fix the bug for three hours before my colleague ___ (find) the problem.
When I ___ (open) the door, the cat ___ (already / escape).
Я устал, потому что работал весь день.
items.answer: I was tired because I had been working all day.

items.prompt: Когда я пришёл, они уже ушли.
items.answer: When I arrived, they had already left. / When I came, they had already left.

items.prompt: Мы ждали уже час, когда он наконец позвонил.
items.answer: We had been waiting for an hour when he finally called.

items.prompt: У неё были красные глаза, потому что она плакала.
items.answer: Her eyes were red because she had been crying.

items.prompt: Пока я писал код, мой коллега пил кофе.
items.answer: While I was writing code, my colleague was drinking coffee.

items.prompt: До этой поездки он никогда не летал на самолёте.
items.answer: He had never flown before this trip. / He had never flown on a plane before this trip.

items.prompt: Сколько времени ты учил английский до того, как переехал?
items.answer: How long had you been learning English before you moved?

items.prompt: Когда я включил компьютер, кто-то уже поменял пароль.
items.answer: When I turned on the computer, someone had already changed the password. / When I turned on my computer, someone had already changed the password.
